notes:
### Ostraca 0.7.19 for Windows

- **Transcripts → Join Teams meeting** is available for the enabled MeetStream account. Paste the Teams invite link and select a library.
- Choose **Save audio only**, **Live transcription only**, or **Save audio and transcribe live**. Live text uses your configured OpenAI transcription model. Keep Transcripts open until the results save.
- This first rollout requests a stop after five minutes including the lobby. MeetStream can charge for bot time and may retain audio. The bot joins only when you tell it to.
- Earlier Vexa recordings remain available for recovery. Saved-file transcription, libraries and account settings are unchanged.
